claims: The 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament runs from March 17 to April 6.
The 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament features live coverage on CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
Streaming of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament is available on Paramount+, HBO Max, and the March Madness Live app.
The First Four of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament is on March 17–18, 2026.
The Final Four of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament is on April 4, 2026, in Indianapolis.
The Championship Game of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament is on April 6, 2026, in Indianapolis.
CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV will share broadcast duties for all games of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament.
Paramount+ streams CBS games of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament.
HBO Max streams TBS, TNT, truTV games of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament.
March Madness Live app streams all games of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament.
Hulu + Live TV, DirecTV, Sling TV, and FuboTV carry CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
Selection Sunday for the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament is March 15, 2026.
First Round of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament is March 19–20, 2026.
Second Round of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament is March 21–22, 2026.
Sweet 16/Elite Eight of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament is March 26–29, 2026.
The NCAA March Madness Live app allows watching every game of the 2026 Men’s March Madness tournament.
The NCAA March Madness Live app requires a TV provider sign-in for TBS, TNT, and truTV games.
